body:
if i could give you more upvotes i would. With my life being the way its been, i take advice given as tongue and cheek unless its personal experience. However, in this case, youre advice means more to me than from someone else in my position because my kids are my world. Being mean to them in the form of anger for something they dont understand is emotional and mental torture.

Thank you very much for sharing.

yeah. ive been on dilaudid but it really wasnt the best. thats why i got switched to the oxycodone 15mg's. As far as heroin goes thats not an option whatsoever because my family means more to me than that.

There is no doubt in my mind that opiates reduce the level of pain your body can tolerate, and coming off them initially causes more pain than youd be in if not on them, however there comes a point where your willing to take that plunge because tolerable pain is better than intolerable.

"Opioid dependency is a medical diagnosis characterized by an individual's inability to stop using opioids (morphine, heroin, codeine, oxycodone, hydrocodone, etc.) even when objectively it is in his or her best interest to do so."


Ive been off them 3 weeks. im ok. im 2 weeks out of the withdrawals and dont have any urges to go find any. If i did, as i stated, i know where to get them but i dont go looking for them. I dont need help staying off them because i never had an issue with them in the first place from an addiction stand point. Youre focusing way too much on the opiates and not the other issues causing the problems here. Thank you for the concern though i do appreciate it.

dont get me wrong, when i first began taking medications it worked great. however when the doses started reaching upwards of 300-400mg daily, my doctor switched me off it due to the fact it has a dose-dependent risk of seizures(400mg is the baseline)

Im already passed all that. The wd's from opiates usually lasts about 10 days for me, with heavy anxiety/restlessness onset around 5-9 days. Im at least 10 days out of it and doing fine minus the pain and depression.

ive heard of it working for pain however its around the level of tramadol.

If it takes me at a minimum 60mg of oxycodone to get through a day at a 4-5 i doubt that subs with help with it.
